column1: # Black/Matrix AD - Chapter 4: The Pope's Three Choices
# No manual wrapping: patchline.py supplies pixel-aware line breaks.

column2: There is nothing to fear!
This person, still mummified with his teeth sunk into my shoulder, is...
the one who ruled this $$世界$$ after the $$創世記戦争$$...
the $$大善神$$, Lord $$ハ・サタン$$!!
And...
through that armor, he has now become part of your soul...
He is the remains of Lord $$メフィスト・フェレス$$!!
What!?
Lord $$サタン$$ and Lord $$メフィスト$$ are the same person...
And he has already died!?
Several years ago...
the body of my husband, the god who ruled this $$世界$$...
Lord $$メフィスト$$ finally died of old age...
The death of a powerful leader means the collapse of order!
Unless Lord $$メフィスト$$'s soul is restored at once, ruin will come for this $$世界$$...
Fearing that, I told only $$ルカ$$ and the others of Lord $$メフィスト$$'s death...
and continued in my role as $$教皇$$, conveying Lord $$サタン$$'s words as before...
I have continued it ever since...
As you already know...
For an $$大天使$$'s soul to fuse with a new vessel and be reborn...
the essential condition is that the natures of both souls be of the same kind!!
Even if one who does not meet that condition wears the armor...
in the end, they will be devoured completely by it...
So I first searched among the children born to Lord $$メフィスト$$ and me, who had settled throughout this $$世界$$,
for a vessel...
that is, a body fit to receive Lord $$メフィスト$$'s soul...
But in the end, every one of my children...
proved unfit to serve as Lord $$メフィスト$$'s vessel!
One had universal $$愛$$...
Another passionate $$愛$$...
Compassionate $$愛$$...
Pure $$愛$$...
Doting $$愛$$...
And $$友愛$$...
All our children inherited not the emotions at the heart of Lord $$メフィスト$$'s soul...
but more strongly the emotions that are the essence of my own soul...
And those emotions originally sprang from the feelings rooted deep in my heart...
the forbidden feelings of $$愛$$ and hate toward Lord $$メフィスト$$!!
What are you saying!?
Then, as the months and years passed, one day...
through information from this $$ルカ$$, I learned that one of my children had committed a taboo...
and was living with a boy who was supposed to be a $$奴隷$$...
in apparent harmony...
So I dispatched the $$異端審問官$$ to that place...
Ever since then...
we have watched over your lives without cease!
The hidden emotion that child discerned sleeping within you...
and the essence of the soul that even defied $$ゴッド$$, ruler of this $$世界$$ before the $$創世記戦争$$...
of Lord $$メフィスト$$, who wished to save the people without $$羽$$ called $$サル$$...
That was the emotion called $$平等$$!!
Now... there are only three paths left for you to choose.
Only three...
The first is to save this $$世界$$ from collapse...
by giving up the life of the one you $$愛$$d...
The second is to fight us as you are, win that battle,
and take on the role of a new $$ゴッド$$...
After this $$世界$$ has collapsed, have her wear the armor of the $$大邪神$$ $$ガブリエル$$ and bring her back...
After this $$世界$$ has collapsed, have him wear the armor of the $$大邪神$$ $$ガブリエル$$ and bring him back...
Even if this $$世界$$ must collapse...
even if every other ally must be sacrificed...
and remake $$この世$$ from the beginning with only the two of you...
That is the way to save only the one you $$愛$$d!
And the third, final path is...
to eat this $$知恵の実$$ to save this $$世界$$ from collapse...
fully recover your $$記憶$$ from when you were Lord $$メフィスト$$...
and become the new ruler...
then, after restoring the $$封印$$ on this $$世界$$'s other $$大邪神$$, have her wear this armor and restore her...
to be received as $$サタン$$'s bride...!
then, after restoring the $$封印$$ on this $$世界$$'s other $$大邪神$$, have him wear this armor and restore him...
to be received as $$サタン$$'s groom...!
This method means...
even killing the other $$大邪神$$ who were once your allies,
in order to save the one you $$愛$$d...!
And in either of those latter two choices...
you will become the god of this new $$世界$$!?
